card.name: Ending pieces of brand and rare names
card.fires_on: The last piece of an unusual capitalized name, such as al in Dianeal, AL in EXTRANEAL, GE in ERIVEDGE, or al in Juvenal and cochineal. It appears after a split-up product or proper name.

modes.label: Dialysis brand endings
modes.description: The ending al or AL of dialysis solution names like Dianeal and Extraneal.

modes.label: Erivedge ending
modes.description: The GE that finishes the drug name Erivedge in capitals.

modes.label: Other names ending in al
modes.description: The al that ends a non-drug name or substance such as Juvenal or cochineal.
modes.example: satire of Juven<<al>>; it embodied the farewell of a poet
